# Capability index

<!-- Generated by scripts/capabilities.py — do not edit by hand. -->

Every public name in gaussx (366 of them), grouped as the API
reference groups it, with the first line of its docstring; then the
public API of the libraries gaussx builds on, and the private toolkits
gaussx's own modules share. Search this page before writing a helper:
if what you need is here, compose it; if it is almost here, extend it
where it lives. Regenerate with `make capabilities` after changing a
public API (`tests/test_capabilities.py` checks it is current).

## [Primitives](api/primitives.md)

### Solve, logdet & Cholesky

| Name | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `solve` | function | Solve A x = b with structural dispatch on the operator type. |
| `logdet` | function | Log-determinant log ∣det A∣ with structural dispatch on the operator type. |
| `cholesky` | function | Lower Cholesky factor L of an operator, structured where A is. |
| `cholesky_logdet` | function | Log-determinant log det A from a Cholesky factor L of A = L Lᵀ. |

### Pseudo-determinant

| Name | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `pseudo_logdet` | function | Log pseudo-determinant: the log of the product of the non-zero eigenvalues. |

### Trace & diagonal

| Name | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `trace` | function | Trace tr(A) of an operator, with structural dispatch. |
| `diag` | function | Diagonal diag(A) of an operator, with structural dispatch. |
| `trace_and_diag` | function | Joint stochastic estimate of tr(A) and diag(A) from one probe pass. |

### Inverse, square root & spectral decompositions

| Name | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `inv` | function | Lazy inverse A⁻¹ of an operator, structured where A is. |
| `sqrt` | function | Principal matrix square root A^½ with structural dispatch, lazy where possible. |
| `eig` | function | Eigenvalues and eigenvectors of A, with structural dispatch. |
| `eigvals` | function | Eigenvalues of A only, with structural dispatch. |
| `svd` | function | Singular value decomposition of A, with structural dispatch. |
| `frobenius_norm` | function | Frobenius norm ‖A‖_F of an operator, with structural dispatch. |
| `submatrix` | function | Sub-matrix A[I, J] of an operator, without forming the full matrix. |

| Name | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `eigh_generalized` | function | Generalised eigenproblem A v = γ B v, A symmetric and B symmetric PSD. |

|---|---|---|

| `sqrt_inv_matmul` | function | Inverse square root times a matrix, A^−½ B, by contour quadrature. |
| `estimate_spectral_bounds` | function | Estimate the extreme eigenvalues (γ_min, γ_max) of a symmetric operator. |

## [Operators & Tags](api/operators.md)

### Structured products & sums

| Name | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `Kronecker` | class | Kronecker product A = A_1 ⊗ … ⊗ A_D, applied one factor at a time. |
| `BlockDiag` | class | Block-diagonal operator A = blockdiag(A_1, …, A_D), one block per slice. |
| `KroneckerSum` | class | Kronecker sum A_1 ⊕ A_2 = A_1 ⊗ I + I ⊗ A_2 of two square operators. |
| `KroneckerSumSqrt` | class | Symmetric square root S of A_1 ⊕ A_2 from the factor eigenvectors. |
| `SumOfKroneckers` | class | Sum of Kronecker products ∑_j A_j ⊗ B_j, applied term by term. |
| `SumOfKroneckersSqrt` | class | Lazy Lanczos square root A^½ of a `SumOfKroneckers` covariance. |

### Low-rank updates

| Name | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `LowRankUpdate` | class | Low-rank update A = A₀ + U D Vᵀ of a base operator, with D = diag(d). |
| `low_rank_plus_diag` | function | Build A = diag(a) + U D Vᵀ, a low-rank update of a diagonal base. |
| `low_rank_plus_identity` | function | Build A = c I + U D Vᵀ, a low-rank update of a scaled identity. |
| `svd_low_rank_plus_diag` | function | Build A = diag(a) + U diag(s) Vᵀ from a truncated SVD. |

### Banded & Toeplitz

| Name | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `BlockTriDiag` | class | Block-tridiagonal operator A with a symmetric off-diagonal band. |
| `LowerBlockTriDiag` | class | Lower block-bidiagonal operator L, the block Cholesky factor of A. |
| `UpperBlockTriDiag` | class | Upper block-bidiagonal operator U, the transpose of a `LowerBlockTriDiag`. |
| `Toeplitz` | class | Symmetric Toeplitz matrix A = toeplitz(t) from its first column t. |
| `ToeplitzCholesky` | class | Circulant-embedding sample factor L, N × M, with L Lᵀ = toeplitz(t). |

|---|---|---|

| `circulant` | function | (Block-)circulant operator C from its first column c. |
| `circulant_from_symbol` | function | (Block-)circulant operator C = DFT⁻¹ diag(γ) DFT from its symbol γ. |
| `as_diagonalized` | function | Express an operator as one `DiagonalizedOperator`, if possible. |
| `SpectralFunction` | class | f(A) = W⁻¹ diag(f(γ)) W for a symmetric A with a factored eigenbasis. |

### Interpolated & masked operators

| Name | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `InterpolatedOperator` | class | Structured kernel interpolation A = W_interp K_ℐℐ W_interpᵀ ≈ K_XX. |
| `MaskedOperator` | class | Row/column-masked view of a base operator. |
| `grid_coupling_indices` | function | Flat indices of masked-out grid cells adjacent to the masked-in region. |

| `grid_data` | function | Inducing inputs X_ℐ, the Cartesian product of the grid axes. |
| `cubic_interpolation_weights` | function | Sparse rows of the cubic SKI interpolation matrix W_interp. |

### Lazy algebra & sampling

|---|---|---|

## [GMRF Precision Builders](api/gmrf.md)

| Name | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `iid_precision` | function | Precision ``τ I`` of ``n`` independent effects with variance ``1/τ``. |
| `rw1_structure` | function | Structure matrix ``R = D₁ᵀ W D₁`` of a first-order random walk. |
| `rw2_structure` | function | Structure matrix ``R = D₂ᵀ D₂`` of a second-order random walk. |
| `ar1_precision` | function | Precision of a stationary AR(1) process with marginal precision ``τ``. |
| `besag_structure` | function | Validate a graph Laplacian as a Besag (ICAR) structure matrix. |
| `generalized_variance_scale` | function | Generalized variance of an intrinsic GMRF (Sørbye & Rue, 2014). |
| `bym2_precision` | function | Joint precision of the BYM2 pair ``(b, u*)`` (Riebler et al., 2016). |
| `spde_precision` | function | SPDE precision ``Q_α = τ² K (C̃⁻¹K)^{α−1}`` with ``K = κ²C̃ + G``. |
| `spde_precision_grid` | function | SPDE precision on a regular grid: a function of a Kronecker sum. |
| `matern_spde_params` | function | SPDE parameters ``(κ, τ, α)`` of a Matérn field. |
| `fem_matrices` | function | Lumped mass ``C̃`` and stiffness ``G`` of P1 elements on a triangle mesh. |
| `fem_projector` | function | Observation matrix ``A`` of P1 interpolation: ``(A w)_k = Σ_i ψ_i(s_k) w_i``. |

## [Solvers & Preconditioners](api/solvers.md)

### The front door

| Name | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `linear_solve` | function | Solve ``A x = b`` through the unified front door. |
| `as_linear_operator` | function | Wrap a raw ``matvec`` callable as a tagged lineax operator. |

### Abstract interfaces

| Name | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `AbstractSolveStrategy` | class | Protocol for linear solve strategies. |
| `AbstractLogdetStrategy` | class | Protocol for log-determinant strategies. |
| `AbstractSolverStrategy` | class | Protocol for solver strategies that pair solve + logdet. |

### Direct & iterative solvers

| Name | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `DenseSolver` | class | Dense solver strategy using gaussx structural dispatch. |
| `AutoSolver` | class | Automatic solver selection based on operator type and size. |
| `CGSolver` | class | Iterative CG solver with stochastic log-determinant. |
| `PreconditionedCGSolver` | class | CG solver with pivoted partial Cholesky preconditioner. |
| `MINRESSolver` | class | MINRES solver for symmetric (possibly indefinite) systems. |
| `LSMRSolver` | class | LSMR iterative least-squares solver (Fong & Saunders 2011). |
| `BBMMSolver` | class | CG solve and SLQ logdet with BBMM's defaults (Gardner et al. 2018). |
| `ComposedSolver` | class | Mix-and-match solve and logdet from different strategies. |
| `KeyedSolver` | class | Bind a PRNG key to a strategy's stochastic log-determinant (gh-384). |
| `LineaxSolver` | class | A lineax solver as a gaussx solve strategy. |
| `SparseCholeskySolver` | class | Exact ``solve`` / ``logdet`` / ``diag_inv`` through a sparse Cholesky factor. |

### Sketch-and-precondition least squares

| Name | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `SketchAndPrecondLSMR` | class | Sketch-and-precondition LSMR for tall least squares (Rokhlin & Tygert, 2008). |
| `sketch_and_solve` | function | Approximate least squares from a sketch. |

### Logdet strategies

| Name | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `DenseLogdet` | class | Dense log-determinant via gaussx structural dispatch. |
| `SLQLogdet` | class | Stochastic log-determinant via Lanczos quadrature (SLQ). |
| `IndefiniteSLQLogdet` | class | Stochastic ``log\|det(A)\|`` for symmetric (possibly indefinite) operators. |
| `NystromLogdet` | class | Nyström-preconditioned log-determinant of $A + \mu I$ (Wenger et al., 2022). |

### Preconditioners

| Name | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `AbstractPreconditioner` | class | Protocol for preconditioners producing an approximate inverse. |
| `JacobiPreconditioner` | class | Diagonal preconditioner ``M^{-1} = diag(1 / \|diag(A)\|)``. |
| `OperatorPreconditioner` | class | Use an externally supplied approximate inverse as a preconditioner. |
| `NystromPreconditioner` | class | Randomized Nyström preconditioner for ``A + μ I``. |
| `PartialCholeskyPreconditioner` | class | Preconditioner from a pivoted partial Cholesky factor. |

## [Linear-Algebra Utilities](api/linalg.md)

### Robust factorization & hygiene

| Name | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `safe_cholesky` | function | Cholesky factor with adaptive diagonal jitter for near-singular matrices. |
| `symmetrize` | function | Symmetric part of the trailing two axes, removing round-off asymmetry. |

### Matrix identities

| Name | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `woodbury_solve` | function | Solve (A + U D Uᵀ) x = b by the Woodbury identity, without the operator. |
| `schur_complement` | function | Schur complement K_XX − K_XZ K_ZZ⁻¹ K_ZX, kept as a low-rank update. |
| `conditional_variance` | function | Predictive variance: the Schur-complement diagonal plus a variational term. |
| `diag_conditional_variance` | function | Diagonal of the Schur complement, max([K_XX]_nn − [A_X K_ZX]_nn, 0). |
| `cov_transform` | function | Covariance propagation through a linear map, J Σ Jᵀ. |
| `sandwich` | function | The sandwich A Σ Aᵀ of two operators, keeping compatible structure. |
| `trace_product` | function | Trace of a product of two operators, tr(A B), with structural dispatch. |

| Name | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `diag_inv` | function | Diagonal of the inverse, diag(A⁻¹), without forming A⁻¹. |
| `selected_inverse` | function | The band of Σ = Λ⁻¹ for a symmetric positive-definite `BlockTriDiag`. |

### Matrix-RHS & batched solves

|---|---|---|

| `solve_columns` | function | Solve A X = B column by column, with structured dispatch per column. |
| `solve_rows` | function | Solve A xᵢ = bᵢ for each row bᵢ of a matrix B, with one solve per row. |
| `tridiagonal_solve` | function | Solve a tridiagonal system A x = b from its three bands. |
| `tridiagonal_solve_batched` | function | Solve independent tridiagonal systems over leading batch axes. |

|---|---|---|

|---|---|---|

## Upstream: `lineax`

The operator protocol, tags and solvers every gaussx operator extends. Use these before wrapping or re-implementing an operator or solver.

| Name | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `AbstractLinearOperator` | class | Abstract base class for all linear operators. |
| `AbstractLinearSolver` | class | Abstract base class for all linear solvers. |
| `AddLinearOperator` | class | A linear operator formed by adding two other linear operators together. |
| `AutoLinearSolver` | class | Automatically determines a good linear solver based on the structure of the operator. |
| `BiCGStab` | class | Biconjugate gradient stabilised method for linear systems. |
| `CG` | class | Conjugate gradient solver for linear systems. |
| `Cholesky` | class | Cholesky solver for linear systems. |
| `ComposedLinearOperator` | class | A linear operator formed by composing (matrix-multiplying) two other linear operators together. |
| `Diagonal` | class | Diagonal solver for linear systems. |
| `DiagonalLinearOperator` | class | A diagonal linear operator, e.g. for a diagonal matrix. |
| `DivLinearOperator` | class | A linear operator formed by dividing a linear operator by a scalar. |
| `FunctionLinearOperator` | class | Wraps a *linear* function `fn: X -> Y` into a linear operator. (So that `self.mv(x)` is defined by `self.mv(x) == fn(x)`.) |
| `GMRES` | class | GMRES solver for linear systems. |
| `IdentityLinearOperator` | class | Represents the identity transformation `X -> X`, where each `x in X` is some PyTree of floating-point JAX arrays. |
| `JacobianLinearOperator` | class | Given a function `fn: X -> Y`, and a point `x in X`, then this defines the linear operator (also a function `X -> Y`) given by the Jacobian `(d(fn)/dx)(x)`. |
| `LSMR` | class | LSMR solver for linear systems. |
| `LU` | class | LU solver for linear systems. |
| `MatrixLinearOperator` | class | Wraps a 2-dimensional JAX array into a linear operator. |
| `MulLinearOperator` | class | A linear operator formed by multiplying a linear operator by a scalar. |
| `NegLinearOperator` | class | A linear operator formed by computing the negative of a linear operator. |
| `Normal` | class | Wrapper for an inner solver of positive (semi)definite systems. |
| `NormalCG` | function | Deprecated helper function. |
| `PyTreeLinearOperator` | class | Represents a PyTree of floating-point JAX arrays as a linear operator. |
| `QR` | class | QR solver for linear systems. |
| `RESULTS` | class | An [enumeration](https://docs.kidger.site/equinox/api/enumerations/), with the following entries: |
| `SVD` | class | SVD solver for linear systems. |
| `Solution` | class | The solution to a linear solve. |
| `TaggedLinearOperator` | class | Wraps another linear operator and specifies that it has certain tags, e.g. representing symmetry. |
| `TangentLinearOperator` | class | Internal to lineax. |
| `Triangular` | class | Triangular solver for linear systems. |
| `Tridiagonal` | class | Tridiagonal solver for linear systems, uses the LAPACK/cusparse implementation of Gaussian elimination with partial pivotting (which increases stability). . |
| `TridiagonalLinearOperator` | class | As `lineax.MatrixLinearOperator`, but for specifically a tridiagonal matrix. |
| `conj` | function | Elementwise conjugate of a linear operator. |
| `diagonal` | function | Extracts the diagonal from a linear operator, and returns a vector. |
| `diagonal_tag` | constant | Structural / property tag for operators. |
| `has_unit_diagonal` | function | Returns whether an operator is marked as having unit diagonal. |
| `invert` | function | Returns a `lineax.FunctionLinearOperator` representing the (pseudo)inverse of `operator`. |
| `is_diagonal` | function | Returns whether an operator is marked as diagonal. |
| `is_lower_triangular` | function | Returns whether an operator is marked as lower triangular. |
| `is_negative_semidefinite` | function | Returns whether an operator is marked as negative semidefinite. |

| `negative_semidefinite_tag` | constant | Structural / property tag for operators. |
| `positive_semidefinite_tag` | constant | Structural / property tag for operators. |

## Upstream: `matfree`

Matrix-free Krylov decompositions, matrix functions and stochastic trace / diagonal estimators. Never hand-roll Lanczos, Arnoldi or Hutchinson.

| `hessenberg` | function | Construct a **Hessenberg-factorisation** via the Arnoldi iteration. |
| `tridiag_sym` | function | Construct an implementation of **tridiagonalisation**. |

## Upstream: `optimistix`

Root finding, fixed points, minimisation and least squares with implicit-differentiation adjoints. Use it instead of a hand-written ``while_loop`` when gradients must flow through the iteration.

| Name | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `AbstractAdjoint` | class | The abstract base class of all adjoints. |
| `AbstractBFGS` | class | Abstract version of the BFGS (Broyden–Fletcher–Goldfarb–Shanno) minimisation algorithm. |
| `AbstractDFP` | class | Abstract version of the DFP (Davidon–Fletcher–Powell) minimisation algorithm. |
| `AbstractDescent` | class | The abstract base class for descents. |
| `AbstractFixedPointSolver` | class | Abstract base class for all fixed point solvers. |
| `AbstractGaussNewton` | class | Abstract base class for all Gauss-Newton type methods. |
| `AbstractGradientDescent` | class | The gradient descent method for unconstrained minimisation. |
| `AbstractIterativeSolver` | class | Abstract base class for all iterative solvers. |
| `AbstractLBFGS` | class | Abstract version of the L-BFGS (limited memory Broyden–Fletcher–Goldfarb–Shanno) solver. |
| `AbstractLeastSquaresSolver` | class | Abstract base class for all least squares solvers. |
| `AbstractMinimiser` | class | Abstract base class for all minimisers. |
| `AbstractQuasiNewton` | class | Abstract quasi-Newton minimisation algorithm. |
| `AbstractRootFinder` | class | Abstract base class for all root finders. |
| `AbstractSearch` | class | The abstract base class for all searches. (Which are our generalisation of line searches, trust regions, and learning rates.) |
| `BFGS` | class | BFGS (Broyden–Fletcher–Goldfarb–Shanno) minimisation algorithm. |
| `BacktrackingArmijo` | class | Perform a backtracking Armijo line search. |
| `BestSoFarFixedPoint` | class | Wraps another fixed-point solver, to return the best-so-far value. |
| `BestSoFarLeastSquares` | class | Wraps another least-squares solver, to return the best-so-far value. |
| `BestSoFarMinimiser` | class | Wraps another minimiser, to return the best-so-far value. |
| `BestSoFarRootFinder` | class | Wraps another root-finder, to return the best-so-far value. |
| `Bisection` | class | The bisection method of root finding. |
| `Chord` | class | The Chord method of root finding. |
| `ClassicalTrustRegion` | class | The classic trust-region update algorithm which uses a quadratic approximation of the objective function to predict reduction. |
| `DFP` | class | DFP (Davidon–Fletcher–Powell) minimisation algorithm. |
| `DampedNewtonDescent` | class | The damped Newton (Levenberg--Marquardt) descent. |
| `Dogleg` | class | Dogleg algorithm. |
| `DoglegDescent` | class | The Dogleg descent step, which switches between the Cauchy and the Newton descent directions. |
| `FixedPointIteration` | class | Repeatedly calls a function in search of a fixed point. |
| `FunctionInfo` | class | Different solvers (BFGS, Levenberg--Marquardt, ...) evaluate different quantities of the objective function. |
| `GaussNewton` | class | Gauss-Newton algorithm, for solving nonlinear least-squares problems. |
| `GoldenSearch` | class | Golden-section search for finding the minimum of a univariate function in a given interval. |
| `GradientDescent` | class | Classic gradient descent with a learning rate `learning_rate`. |
| `ImplicitAdjoint` | class | Backpropagate via the [implicit function theorem](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Implicit_function_theorem). |
| `IndirectDampedNewtonDescent` | class | The indirect damped Newton (Levenberg--Marquardt) trust-region descent. |
| `IndirectLevenbergMarquardt` | class | The Levenberg--Marquardt method as a true trust-region method. |
| `LBFGS` | class | L-BFGS (Limited-memory Broyden–Fletcher–Goldfarb–Shanno) minimisation algorithm. |
| `LearningRate` | class | Move downhill by taking a step of the fixed size `learning_rate`. |
| `LevenbergMarquardt` | class | The Levenberg--Marquardt method. |
| `LinearTrustRegion` | class | The trust-region update algorithm which uses a linear approximation of the objective function to predict reduction. |
| `NelderMead` | class | The Nelder-Mead minimisation algorithm. (Downhill simplex derivative-free method.) |
| `Newton` | class | Newton's method for root finding. |
| `NewtonDescent` | class | Newton descent direction. |
| `NonlinearCG` | class | The nonlinear conjugate gradient method. |
| `NonlinearCGDescent` | class | The nonlinear conjugate gradient step. |
| `OptaxMinimiser` | class | A wrapper to use Optax first-order gradient-based optimisers with `optimistix.minimise`. |
| `RESULTS` | class | An [enumeration](https://docs.kidger.site/equinox/api/enumerations/), with the following entries: |
| `RecursiveCheckpointAdjoint` | class | Backpropagate by differentiating through the iterates directly. |
| `Solution` | class | The solution to a nonlinear solve. |
| `SteepestDescent` | class | The descent direction given by locally following the gradient. |
| `dai_yuan` | function | The Dai--Yuan formula for β. |
| `fixed_point` | function | Find a fixed-point of a function. |
| `fletcher_reeves` | function | The Fletcher--Reeves formula for β. |

## Shared private toolkits

Not public API: the plumbing gaussx's own modules share. Contributors
use these instead of writing new helpers; a helper two modules need is
added here, not inline in one caller.

| Module | Purpose | Helpers |
|---|---|---|
| `gaussx._einx` | Typed einx adapters for tensor reshaping and contraction. | `rearrange`, `repeat`, `reduce`, `einsum` |
| `gaussx._testing` | Test utilities for gaussx. | `default_tolerances`, `tree_allclose`, `_resolve_dtype`, `key_sequence`, `random_pd_matrix`, `random_pd_operator`, `psd_operator`, `random_kronecker_pd`, `random_block_diag_pd`, `random_low_rank_update`, `random_sum_of_kroneckers_pd`, `random_spd_block_tridiag`, `empirical_moments`, `dense_solve`, `dense_logdet`, `dense_inv`, `dense_diag`, `dense_trace`, `assert_sample_moments` |
| `gaussx._deprecation` | gaussx's own deprecation warning category and helper (gh-332). | `GaussxDeprecationWarning`, `renamed_attribute`, `warn_deprecated`, `renamed_kwargs` |
| `gaussx._operators._utils` | Private utilities shared by operator implementations. | `lineax_diagonal`, `_square_components`, `lineax_conj`, `register_lineax_structure_functions`, `_identity` |
| `gaussx._strategies._dispatch` | Dispatch helpers: route through solver strategy or fall back to primitives. | `dispatch_solve`, `dispatch_logdet` |
| `gaussx._strategies._tolerances` | Dtype-aware default tolerances for the iterative strategies (gh-327). | `operator_dtype`, `resolve_tolerance`, `rhs_scaling` |
| `gaussx._strategies._lineax` | Adapter from a lineax solver to a gaussx solve strategy (gh-376). | `LineaxSolver`, `as_solve_strategy` |
| `gaussx._distributions._utils` | Shared helpers for batched distribution reshaping. | `_axis_names`, `_reshape_batch`, `_reshape_series`, `_reshape_samples`, `_unflatten_sample_axis` |
| `gaussx._ssm._utils` | Shared helpers for the SSM recipes. | `_materialise`, `_matvec`, `_as_operator`, `_right_matmul_transpose`, `_left_matmul`, `_innovation_covariance`, `_masked_obs_inputs`, `_is_operator_input`, `_normalise_tv_inputs`, `_warn_unused_process_noise`, `_transition_stack` |
